practice.title: Social Studies
contexts: W1 background: A city-state/community with its own political organization. Mountains could separate communities; seas supported travel/trade. This is an assessment background note written for this packet, not an actual historical primary-source quotation.

items.prompt: Name one kind of source that could help check the background note and explain why.
items.answer: A relevant map, scholarly/educator text, community source, historical document, or data record; source must match the claim. One point for suitable source and one for purpose.

items.prompt: Model Greek geography and city-state connections.
items.answer: Rubric (3): accurate relevant content (1); supported comparison/relationship (1); clear organization and source/evidence awareness (1). Location/barriers/routes and plausible effects without geographic determinism.

items.prompt: Why test an algorithm?
items.answer: To find unclear, missing, or incorrect steps.

items.prompt: Why label planting conditions?
